entities.name: Samuel Abraham Poznański
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Samuel Abraham Poznański or Shemuel Avraham Poznanski was a Polish-Jewish scholar, known for his studies of Karaism and the Hebrew calendar. Arabist, Hebrew bibliographer, and authority on modern Karaism; rabbi and preacher at the Great Synagogue in Warsaw.
